description: Implementation class for DiagnosisService in OpenMRS, handling diagnosis-related business logic, data access, and service methods.

classes.name: DiagnosisServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for managing diagnoses, integrating with DAO layer, and providing business logic for diagnosis operations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a diagnosis object to the database.

methods.name: voidDiagnosis
methods.description: Voids a diagnosis with a specified reason.

methods.name: getDiagnosisByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis by its UUID.

methods.name: getDiagnoses
methods.description: Gets active diagnoses for a patient from a specific date.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with a specific encounter.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with a specific visit.

methods.name: getPrimaryDiagnoses
methods.description: Gets primary diagnoses for an encounter.

methods.name: getUniqueDiagnoses
methods.description: Retrieves unique diagnoses since a specific date for a patient.

methods.name: getDiagnosis
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis by internal ID.

methods.name: unvoidDiagnosis
methods.description: Revives or unvoids a diagnosis.

methods.name: purgeDiagnosis
methods.description: Permanently deletes a diagnosis from the database.

methods.name: getDiagnosisDAO
methods.description: Accessor for the DiagnosisDAO object.

methods.name: setDiagnosisDAO
methods.description: Setter for the DiagnosisDAO object.

methods.name: getAllDiagnosisAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all diagnosis attribute types.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis attribute type by ID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis attribute type by UUID.

methods.name: saveDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a diagnosis attribute type.

methods.name: retireDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Retires a diagnosis attribute type.

methods.name: unretireDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Unretire a diagnosis attribute type.

methods.name: purgeDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a diagnosis attribute type.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis attribute by UUID.
